title: Welcome - Clear Mint Home
audience: New PayProxy learners and design reviewers exploring the Clear Mint Home welcome experience in test mode, including Cash App, Chime and prepaid users learning visual flow.
objectives: Recognize the two-column hero with calm-blue action and phone-friendly stacking
Identify feature rows showing cards with caps, balance at a glance, and history
Recall tinted mint bands as separators and midnight ledger band as call-to-action
Understand footer closure and that no features or wording changed, only look and motion

sections.title: Hero: Two-Column Headline with Calm-Blue Action
sections.bodyMarkdown: The hero presents a two-column layout on desktop with a bold headline on the left and a supporting illustration on the right, while the primary call-to-action uses a calm-blue fill with generous padding and rounded corners for a trustworthy feel. On narrower screens the columns stack vertically with the headline and description staying on top and the visual dropping below, preserving comfortable reading width and thumb-friendly tap targets without shifting hierarchy. Subtle RevealOnScroll fade and gentle upward drift introduce content as it enters view, with soft easing that never distracts from reading. Typography remains large and airy with ample white space, mint-tinted background keeps contrast high, and button hover shows only a slight darkening. No features were added, removed, or altered and no wording was changed; this description covers look and motion only.
sections.analogy: Like a bright bank lobby with clear signs, the hero shows a welcome desk on the left and an illustrated guide poster on the right, both pointing to one calm-blue help button, stacking neatly like chairs against a wall on a narrow phone screen.
sections.pitch30s: In thirty seconds, notice the hero: two columns on desktop, headline and calm-blue button on the left, visual on the right, stacking vertically on phones so nothing crowds. Soft fade and gentle rise animate on scroll, but no words or features changed. It feels open and trustworthy, like entering a sunlit lobby where the main action is obvious and thumb-friendly.
keyPoints: Two columns on desktop stack to single column on mobile preserving headline hierarchy
Calm-blue primary button with rounded corners and generous padding signals trust
RevealOnScroll fade and slight upward drift with no feature or wording changes

quiz.question: How does the hero behave on phones?
options: Columns stack vertically keeping headline on top
quiz.explanation: On narrow screens columns stack vertically with headline and description on top and visual below, preserving hierarchy and tap targets.

quiz.question: What does the calm-blue button indicate?
quiz.explanation: Calm-blue fill with padding and rounded corners marks the primary action while keeping high contrast and subtle hover only.

sections.title: Feature Rows: Cards with Caps, Balance, and History
sections.bodyMarkdown: Three feature rows sit in clean white cards centered on a pale mint page, each row pairing a simple icon on the left with a short heading, brief line, and secondary detail on the right. The cards show capped cards, balance at a glance, and transaction history as visual concepts only, arranged with even gutters and soft rounded corners that create rhythm without clutter. Motion is restrained: each card reveals with a light fade and slight rise when scrolled into view, staggered by a fraction so the eye follows top to bottom naturally. Hover offers only a faint shadow lift, no color flash, keeping focus on readability and calm pacing. Alignment stays left-to-right on desktop and stacks neatly on mobile with icons above text where needed. Spacing, type scale, and dividers remain identical to before. No features were added or changed and no wording was altered; this section describes appearance and gentle animation only.
sections.analogy: Like a tidy store display with three labeled shelves, each card shows capped cards, balance at a glance, and history in its own bin, evenly spaced so shoppers find what they need without clutter.
sections.pitch30s: Thirty seconds on features: three white cards on pale mint, each with icon and text for caps, balance, and history. Even gutters and rounded corners create rhythm. Cards fade in staggered as you scroll, hover lifts shadow faintly. Layout stacks on mobile, no words or features changed, just calm visual order.
keyPoints: White cards on mint background show capped cards, balance at glance, and history as visual concepts
Even gutters, soft corners, and left-icon alignment create rhythm
Staggered fade-rise on scroll and faint hover shadow, no feature or wording changes

quiz.question: What do the three cards visually represent?
options: Capped cards, balance at a glance, history
quiz.explanation: Cards illustrate capped cards, balance at a glance, and history as visual concepts without changing functionality.

quiz.question: How is motion handled for feature cards?
options: Staggered fade and rise on scroll with subtle hover lift
quiz.explanation: Each card reveals with light fade and slight rise staggered top to bottom, hover adds only faint shadow.

sections.title: Tinted Mint Bands Separating Content
sections.bodyMarkdown: Tinted mint bands act as soft dividers that breathe between denser content blocks, stretching full width with a very light mint wash behind centered text and delicate line icons. The bands use generous vertical padding and slightly increased letter spacing to feel airy and calm, contrasting with the crisp white cards above and below. Visually they create pause points that guide the eye without adding new content or calls to action. Motion is minimal and soothing: when a band enters the viewport it fades in smoothly and its inner elements drift upward just a few pixels, then settle, supporting a relaxed scroll rhythm. On mobile the bands maintain full bleed and keep text comfortably narrow for readability. Colors stay within the clear mint palette with high contrast for accessibility, and no border or shadow competes for attention. No features or functionality were modified and no wording was changed; the bands are purely presentational separators describing look, spacing, and subtle motion only.
sections.analogy: Like fresh mint dividers between library shelves, light tinted bands give your eyes a pause, marking where one topic ends and the next begins without adding new books.
sections.pitch30s: In thirty seconds, see the mint bands: full-width light washes with centered text and icons, generous padding that lets the page breathe between white cards. They fade in softly with a tiny upward drift, staying full-bleed on mobile. No features or wording changed, just airy separators for calm pacing.
keyPoints: Full-width pale mint washes with centered text act as breathable dividers
Generous padding and letter spacing contrast white cards above and below
Minimal fade and drift on entry, no feature or wording changes

quiz.question: What is the purpose of mint bands?
quiz.explanation: Mint bands are presentational separators that create breathing room between denser blocks.

quiz.question: How do mint bands animate?
options: Soft fade and few-pixel drift then settle
quiz.explanation: Motion is minimal: smooth fade and tiny upward drift on viewport entry to support relaxed scrolling.

sections.title: Midnight Ledger Call-to-Action Band
sections.bodyMarkdown: The midnight ledger band anchors the page near the bottom with a deep navy background that signals a clear next step without feeling heavy. Centered white headline and supporting line sit above a calm-blue primary button that holds strong contrast against the dark field, surrounded by ample negative space so the action feels focused and confident. The band spans full width with subtle top and bottom rounding that softens the transition from light to dark. Reveal motion is restrained: the band fades in as a whole with a gentle upward glide, and the button responds to hover with only a slight brightness shift, avoiding bounce or flash. On small screens the headline stacks above the button with comfortable padding, preserving legibility and tap size. No icons crowd the area and no additional links compete. No features were introduced or removed and no wording was edited; this description explains only colors, layout, spacing, and calm motion for visual emphasis.
sections.analogy: Like a hotel concierge desk in deep navy with a bright desk lamp, the dark band highlights one clear next step, making the calm-blue button easy to spot against the night tone.
sections.pitch30s: Thirty seconds on the midnight band: deep navy full-width strip near the bottom, white headline above calm-blue button, ample space so focus stays sharp. Fades in as a whole with gentle glide, hover brightens slightly. Stacks on phones, no features or words changed, just confident visual emphasis.
keyPoints: Deep navy full-width band with white text and calm-blue button for strong contrast
Ample negative space and soft rounding ease transition from light to dark
Restrained fade and glide, hover brightness shift only, no feature or wording changes

quiz.question: Why use midnight navy for this band?
options: To anchor next step with confident contrast for the calm-blue action
quiz.explanation: Deep navy signals a focused next step and makes white text and calm-blue button stand out with high contrast.

quiz.question: How does the band behave on small screens?
options: Headline stacks above button with comfortable padding and tap size
quiz.explanation: Layout stacks vertically preserving legibility and thumb-friendly tap targets while keeping full width.

sections.title: Footer: Quiet Close
sections.bodyMarkdown: The footer closes the page in a clean, minimal strip with light gray background, centered links, and small muted text that feels quiet after the bold midnight band. Content is arranged in a single row on desktop with evenly spaced navigation items and copyright line, then stacks vertically on mobile with generous line height to prevent mis-taps. Typography drops one scale step to signal secondary information while maintaining legibility and high contrast. No animation draws attention here; at most a soft fade on scroll entry keeps the experience consistent without distraction. Spacing feels balanced with padding above and below that lets the footer breathe. Icons are absent and dividers are whisper-thin, reinforcing a tidy, trustworthy finish. Interaction stays simple with underline on hover only. No features were added, altered, or removed and no wording was changed; this footer description covers only visual hierarchy, spacing, responsiveness, and stillness of motion to complete the page calmly.
sections.analogy: Like the small exit sign and hours plaque by a lobby door, the footer sits quietly at the end, single-row on desktop and stacked on phone, giving final details without competing for attention.
sections.pitch30s: Final thirty seconds: light gray footer strip with centered links and muted text, single row on desktop, stacked on mobile with tall line height. No animation except soft fade, underline on hover only. No features or wording changed, just calm, trustworthy closure with clear hierarchy and spacing.
keyPoints: Light gray strip with centered links and small muted text signals secondary info
Single row desktop, vertical stack mobile with generous line height
Soft fade entry and underline on hover only, no feature or wording changes

quiz.question: How is footer layout handled?
options: Single row desktop, vertical stack mobile with breathing padding
quiz.explanation: Footer uses single row on desktop and vertical stack on mobile with generous padding and line height.

quiz.question: What is the footer interaction style?
options: Simple underline on hover, minimal motion
quiz.explanation: Footer stays quiet with only underline on hover and at most soft fade, keeping focus on secondary info.

accessibilityNotes: Accessibility: Respects reduced-motion via prefers-reduced-motion where RevealOnScroll pauses fade and drift animations; maintains logical keyboard tab order hero > features > mint bands > midnight CTA > footer with visible focus rings on all interactive elements and high contrast calm-blue on white and white on midnight navy.
